title: performance-canary: enhanced auto-detection and rollout guards for latency/throughput regressions
author: Aisha Patel
description: Motivation: production rollouts have surface-level protection for functional regressions but limited automated detection for subtle performance regressions that affect latency p50/p90/p99 and throughput. This PR extends the perf-canary pipeline to add automated detection logic for latency and throughput regressions, integrates KV-cache-aware checks, and implements rollout guards with hysteresis so temporary noise doesn't block rollouts but sustained regressions trigger automatic hold/rollback. The implementation includes a new detector service, configurable thresholds and hysteresis windows, signal aggregation across replicas, and a canary policy engine that evaluates combined risk before allowing traffic shifts. The PR also adds end-to-end tests, a lightweight local simulator for threshold tuning, and dashboards/alerts for the new signals. This description is a single continuous string and includes the rationale, design summary, and rollout guard behaviour. Highlights: 1) new detector: perf_canary/detector which consumes latency and throughput time-series, computes distributions, and raises regression events when relative change exceeds configured thresholds and persists for the hysteresis window; 2) KV-cache awareness: detector normalizes latency signals by prefix-cache-hit-rate so model warm/cold starts don't produce false positives; 3) rollout guards: canary-policy evaluates health signals (p99 latency, p90 latency, throughput, error-rate, cache-hit) and supports policies: allow, hold, rollback; supports automatic rollback with annotation and optional manual override; 4) tuning and safety: default thresholds conservative (p99 +10% sustained 5m, throughput -15% sustained 3m), autoscaling hysteresis integrated to avoid conflicts; 5) metrics and observability: new metrics perf_canary.detector.* and perf_canary.policy.* plus Grafana dashboard panels and alert rules; 6) tests: unit detector tests, integration test for policy decisions with simulated traffic, perf-suite smoke tests to validate no regressions on common models. Migration notes: canary config schema extended with detector and policy blocks, old configs still supported but will log a deprecation warning. Backwards-compatible no-op by default for existing customers unless the detector is enabled for an org.
merge_commit_summary: perf(canary): add detector service + policy engine for automated latency/throughput regression detection and rollout guards
